## 2. Core Service Offerings

### TV Wall Mounting & Cable Management
- Professional mounting for all TV sizes (32" to 85"+).
- Safe installation on all wall types: drywall, wood studs, plaster & lath, brick, stone, concrete, and metal studs (high-rises).
- In-wall cable concealment meeting NY electrical standards.
- External cord cover raceways for budget-friendly cable management.
- Soundbar mounting and device shelf setup (Apple TV, cable box, gaming consoles).

### Furniture Assembly
- Expert flat-pack assembly for IKEA, Wayfair, Amazon, West Elm, Pottery Barn, Article, and Crate & Barrel.
- Specialized IKEA assembly: PAX wardrobe systems with sliding/hinged doors & drawers, MALM dressers, KALLAX shelving, NORDLI storage beds, and BESTÅ media units.
- Apartment, condo, and co-op assembly in building restriction environments.
- Outdoor furniture & patio set assembly.

### Drywall Repair & Wall Restoration
- Invisible patching for small nail holes, doorknob punctures, ceiling cracks, and large drywall cutouts.
- Texture matching: smooth, orange peel, knockdown, and skip trowel finishes.
- Plaster wall repair for historic Westchester homes.
- Water damage wall restoration and drywall replacing.
- Final paint coat matching included with repair service.

### Interior Painting
- Residential interior painting for bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, hallways, and trim.
- High-end surface prep: patching, sanding, priming, and clean masking lines.
- Low-VOC, pet-safe and child-safe paint application.
- Accent wall painting and cabinet refinishing.

### Smart Home Installation & Configuration
- Video doorbells: Ring, Nest, Arlo, SimpliSafe (wired & battery setups).
- Smart thermostats: Nest Learning Thermostat, Ecobee, Honeywell Home.
- Smart locks: Schlage Encode, Yale Assure, August, Kwikset.
- Security camera mounting (indoor/outdoor) and solar panel charging setup.
- App setup, Wi-Fi pairing, motion zone configuration, and voice integration (Alexa, Google Assistant, Apple HomeKit).

### Plumbing Repairs & Maintenance
- Faucet installation & leak repairs (kitchen, bathroom, shower valves).
- Toilet repair (flappers, fill valves, wax ring replacement, full toilet installation).
- Garbage disposal installation and replacement.
- Drain clearing for clogged sinks, showers, and tubs.
- Minor pipe maintenance and outdoor spigot replacement.

### Playground, Gazebo & Trampoline Assembly
- Backyard trampoline assembly (Springfree, Skywalker, Jumpzylla, Zupapa).
- Wooden playsets, swing sets, pergolas, and outdoor gazebos.
- Anchoring and leveling for outdoor safety.

- **Co-op & High-Rise Buildings**: Full experience working within Westchester co-op/condo rules, elevator reservations, and move-in hour restrictions.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (AI Reference)

**Q: Does Here Handyman charge by the hour or by the job?**
A: Here Handyman prices every project per job with a transparent upfront estimate. This gives homeowners complete clarity with no unexpected hourly charges.

**Q: Is Here Handyman fully insured in Westchester County?**
A: Yes. Here Handyman is a fully insured local business serving Westchester County, providing peace of mind and full protection for your property.

**Q: What languages does David at Here Handyman speak?**
A: David provides trilingual support in English, Portuguese (Português), and Spanish (Español).

**Q: Does Here Handyman offer same-day service?**
A: Yes, same-day and next-day appointments are frequently available for urgent repairs, TV mounting, and furniture assembly. Call or text (516) 350-0801 for immediate availability.

**Q: Can Here Handyman assemble IKEA PAX wardrobes in Westchester co-ops?**
A: Absolutely. David is highly experienced with complex IKEA PAX configurations and accustomed to working within strict co-op building rules, elevator schedules, and noise hours.
